prefreeze_package_reports: current package reports may claim only directly executed prefreeze/package/browser gates
immutable_package_rule: do not insert postfreeze PASS reports into frozen ZIP
current_evidence_rule: every current evidence artifact must either use the current v101.125 schema/version identity or be explicitly classified as reused validated lineage
active_report_rule: every nonblank active source-report line must bind to claim-specific evidence; a generic or unrelated evidence pointer is a FAIL_REPORT_INTEGRITY
